Variants.Content: Entry Marriage alliances, hostages, and guardianships are common tools used by Westeros nobles to maintain peace, exchange trust, and limit hostility. The marriage contract tied the inheritance of land, military support and family prestige to the next generation; the children were sent to another castle to be raised, with the possibility of gaining division commanders Etiquette calls these arrangements honor, kinship, or education, but participants often feel responsibilities, opportunities, and being used at the same time. Whether any marriage is completed or whether any hostage is safe is a variable future; the system itself's role in shaping the politics of the seven countries remains unchanged.

Entry Political Marriages Marriage Alliances, Hostages, and Wardship: Marriage alliances, hostages, and guardianships are common tools used by Westeros nobles to maintain peace, exchange trust, and limit hostility. The marriage contract tied the inheritance of land, military support and family prestige to the next generation; the children were sent to another castle to be raised, with the possibility of gaining division commanders. They start by asking who is obligated, who is protected, and who will seek justice after a breach of contract.
